logline: Disguised as a common scullery maid, Lady Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor alongside Prudence and slips into the forbidden West Wing, where she discovers the dying Dowager Duchess suffering from an unnatural, poisoned affliction.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 21 where Prudence revealed that the Dowager Duchess is dying from a mysterious illness; Juliana sets aside her aristocratic identity to sneak into Ashbury Manor under the guise of domestic help to save her.

scenes.heading: EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVICE COURTYARD – DAY

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot framing the gothic stone archway of Ashbury Manor as other maidservants carrying laundry baskets pass through the damp courtyard.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Juliana walks nervously along the stone pavement dressed in a modest dark maid's dress and a plain white apron, looking around cautiously.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana adjusting her high buttoned collar, anxious yet determined, against the backdrop of the gloomy coast.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Prudence rushes up behind Lady Juliana, pulling her into the shelter of the stone archway.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Urgent, Whispering)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: Keep your head down. If anyone recognizes you, everything is over.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana leaning back against the rough stone wall, whispering back firmly.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Quiet)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: No one will recognize me dressed like this.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Prudence glancing nervously toward the courtyard before fixing her gaze on Juliana.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Nervous, Warning)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: This is Ashburton Manor. The housekeeper watches everyone. Lady Catherine watches everyone, and Lord Rupert...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana cutting in with fierce, unyielding conviction.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Determined)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: The Duchess is dying.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot looking up at Lady Juliana and Prudence standing beneath the looming stone facade of the manor.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Defiant, Firm)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: I saved Toby. I can save her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Prudence, her eyes wide with dread.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Fretful)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: And if they discover who you are?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Lady Juliana holding her gaze steadily.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Steely, Selfless)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Then I will face that when she is breathing again.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot outside the heavy wooden servant entrance door.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Solemn)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: Then forget you were ever a lady.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana swallowing her pride and accepting her perilous disguise.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Quietly Resolute)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Today, I am only a maid.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Prudence opens the heavy wooden service door, and both women step inside into the dark servants' corridor as the door shuts firmly behind them.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Heavy wooden latch clicks shut with a thud.

scenes.heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVANTS' CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS

segments.label: HOUSEKEEPER (Sharp, Stern, O.S.)
segments.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
segments.text: Prudence.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the formidable Housekeeper standing in the dim stone hallway with arms folded, ring of keys dangling from her waist.

segments.label: HOUSEKEEPER (Suspicious)
segments.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
segments.text: Who is this?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Prudence curtsying low with downcast eyes while Lady Juliana stands behind her carrying a heavy wooden water bucket.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Submissive)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: Julian, ma'am. New help for the winter cleaning.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up profile of the Housekeeper sizing up Juliana critically.

segments.label: HOUSEKEEPER (Cold, Skeptical)
segments.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
segments.text: She looks soft.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Close-up on Lady Juliana's hands gripping the iron handle of the wooden wash bucket firmly.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Lady Juliana keeping her eyes dutifully lowered.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Humble, Steady)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: I can work, ma'am.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot of the Housekeeper staring down coldly.

segments.label: HOUSEKEEPER (Demanding)
segments.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
segments.text: Can you scrub stone?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Lady Juliana nodding slightly.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Subdued)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Yes, ma'am.

segments.label: HOUSEKEEPER (Harsh, O.S.)
segments.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
segments.text: Carry coal?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Housekeeper's stern face.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Cut back to Lady Juliana maintaining her meek posture.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Polite)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Yes, ma'am.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Profile medium two-shot as the Housekeeper steps right up into Lady Juliana's face, staring intently into her downcast eyes.

segments.label: HOUSEKEEPER (Menacing, Threatening)
segments.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
segments.text: And can you keep your eyes and ears where they belong?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up on Lady Juliana's composed, lowered face.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Subdued, Steady)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Yes, ma'am.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Housekeeper turning and pointing a bony finger toward the servant corridor stairs.

segments.label: HOUSEKEEPER (Stern, Dismissive)
segments.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
segments.text: Then prove it. The manor has no use for useless girls.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Housekeeper turns and stalks away down the corridor. Prudence exhales a trembling breath of relief.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the dimly lit hallway showing the Housekeeper walking away into the distance.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Relieved, Whispering)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: That was close.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Lady Juliana clutching the wash bucket, her eyes scanning ahead urgently.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Urgent, Quiet)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Where is the West Wing?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Prudence pointing toward the archway leading toward the grand staircase.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Nervous, Warning)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: Beyond the grand staircase. Few servants go there.

scenes.heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – GRAND ENTRANCE HALL – CONTINUOUS

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tracking shot from behind Lady Juliana as she walks out into the vast, opulent marble hall of Ashbury Manor carrying her bucket.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Juliana stops in her tracks and gazes upward in awe at the soaring gilded ceilings and aristocratic crest.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle push-in on Lady Juliana looking up at the enormous portrait of the late Duke and Duchess hanging above the gallery.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Breathless)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: This house...

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Prudence rushes into frame, grabbing Juliana's arm to keep her moving.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Prudence whispering frantically into Juliana's ear.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Panicked, Hushed)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: Do not stare. Keep walking.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide tracking shot behind Lady Juliana as she hastens down the long marble gallery toward the secluded West Wing wing.

scenes.heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – CONTINUOUS

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Lady Juliana standing outside a massive carved mahogany door, glancing around the empty hallway to ensure she is unobserved.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Juliana reaches out with a trembling hand and quietly turns the ornate brass and glass door knob.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana's hand twisting the latch handle.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Faint, muffled click of the heavy door lock turning.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Slow tracking shot into the cavernous, shadowy bedchamber. In the center stands an ornate four-poster canopy bed draped in pale silk where a frail, silver-haired figure lies motionless.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Labored, raspy, shallow breathing echoing in the quiet room.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Juliana hurries inside, sets the wooden bucket onto the floor, and rushes to the bedside.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Concerned)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Your Grace?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped on pillows, her face gaunt, ashen, and drenched in cold sweat, her eyes half-fluttering.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana taking the Duchess's fragile, cold hands into her own.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Soft, Comforting)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Do not speak.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana checking the Duchess's pulse and gently pressing her fingertips against the Duchess's chest and neck, her herbalist instincts taking over.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Juliana's eyes widen with sudden, horrifying realization.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Shocked, Murmuring)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: This isn't ordinary fever.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Dowager Duchess suddenly gasps violently for breath, convulsing weakly as her eyes snap open in agony.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Duchess gasping in sudden spasms.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Intense two-shot as Lady Juliana leans in close, gripping the Duchess's shoulder with urgent desperation.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Urgent, Alarmed)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Who has been treating you?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up on the Dowager Duchess's terrified, wide eyes staring up as she chokes for air, the haunting realization of poison lingering as dramatic music hits an abrupt, suspenseful cliffhanger.
